title: 第19章 继续改造碧落兰第20章 种植碧落兰
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
“张二狗说的也有些道理，我们这样回来，若是被紫云宗发现了，也会牵连到整个东宁村。”
“所以，我准备将东宁村也变成我们筹码的一部分。”夏以苜眼睛异常明亮。
“东宁村的人早些年以种植草药为生，这些年帮紫云宗种了些低阶灵植，也算是有些种植经验。”
“既然如此，让他们种一种七阶灵植也不过分吧？”
夏以苜就这么用闲聊的语气，说出来能让人惊掉下巴的话。
连沉默许久的陆兜兜都没忍住惊呼出声，“你不会想让他们种碧落兰吧？”
他们最近接触过的七阶灵植只有碧落兰。
她转头看向陆兜兜，唇角勾着笑容，“不可以吗？”
她的语气那样自信，好似这是什么理所当然的事情。
陆兜兜噎了一瞬，一时间不知道如何反驳。
愣了一会儿后才继续道：“想想也知道这是不可能的事情。”
“你能种出碧落兰，那是因为你已经是修士，而且你对灵植还很了解。”
其实这么说也有些怪，夏以苜之前只是一个凡人，环境便限制了她难以对高阶灵植有什么了解。
但事实就是，夏以苜对高阶灵植不是一般的了解，这一点陆兜兜不得不承认。
这样的人只是个例，总不能东宁村人人都是隐藏的药修大能吧？
“可你此刻要让那些凡人来种植碧落兰，连给碧落兰供应基本的灵气都做不到。”
不是陆兜兜看不起凡人，是碧落兰这样的灵植在成长过程中需要大量的灵气。
若是环境中的灵气不够，便需要修士用自身灵力来补足。
“不试试怎么知道呢？”夏以苜的声音轻松。
神态语气和之前她说试着查出碧落兰真相时一样。

上一次她说试试，结果便在三天的时间里种出来了三株碧落兰，还找出了碧落兰的新特性。
这一次她也说试试。
陆兜兜的表情逐渐古怪，不会真的能成吧？
夏以苜身上好似有一种神奇的魔力，不管是按多么离谱的事情，在她的身上都可能变为现实。
“我才不信。”陆兜兜撇了撇嘴，“若是随便一个村子的人都能种七阶灵植，那紫云宗这样的宗门还有什么存在的必要。”
夏以苜没再多说，等她把事实摆在面前的时候，不信也得信了。
“走吧，先去村子里看看。”她起身，准备去查看东宁村的土质情况，挑选一块风水宝地。
林朔风主打一个夏以苜去哪儿他去哪儿，快步跟上。
陆萍萍也连忙追上，夏以苜的话她还是很信的，“苜苜姐，你等等我，能不能也教我种碧落兰呀。”
“当然可以，之前都答应你了。”
听着那声音越来越远，陆兜兜虽然很不情愿，但也只能跟上去。
村子东边是一大片平地，专门为了种植灵植开拓出来的田地。
上一波的灵植已经收起来交给紫云宗，下一批灵植还未种下，如今大部分的地都还空着。
夏以苜蹲下，取了一部分泥土，在指尖上搓捻。
将自身的灵力注入其中，便可感知其中灵气涌动，比现代那些仪器分析方便得太多。
在与植物有关的一切事情上，她都像是无师自通，甚至不用旁人告知她，她便知道该怎么做。
“姐，你觉得怎么样？”林朔风虽然是剑修，但也知道种植灵植前，需要评判一下那片土地的质量如何。
这片土地的质量，陆萍萍和陆兜兜甚至都不用细看，扫一眼便知道是中二阶灵植都费力的程度。
content_en:
"What Zhang Ergou said makes sense. If we come back like this and are discovered by the Ziyun Sect, the entire Dongning Village will be implicated."
"So, I am going to make Dongning Village part of our bargaining chip." Xia Yilu's eyes were extremely bright.
"People in Dongning Village made a living by growing herbal medicine in the early years. In recent years, they have helped Ziyun Sect grow some low-level spiritual plants, which can be considered as some planting experience."
"In this case, it wouldn't be too much to let them plant a seventh-level spiritual plant, right?"
Xia Yihuo just used a chatty tone and said words that would make people's jaws drop.
Even Lu Doudou, who had been silent for a long time, couldn't help but exclaimed, "You don't want them to plant blue orchids, do you?"
The only seventh-level spiritual plant they have come into contact with recently is Biluolan.
She turned to look at Lu Doudou, with a smile on her lips, "Can't you?"
Her tone was so confident, as if this was a matter of course.
Lu Doudou choked for a moment and didn't know how to refute.
After being stunned for a while, he continued: "If you think about it, you know this is impossible."
"You can grow Biluolan because you are already a monk and you know a lot about spiritual plants."
In fact, it's a bit strange to say this. Xia Yihuo was just a mortal before, so her environment limited her ability to understand high-level spiritual plants.
But the fact is that Xia Yilu has an unusual understanding of high-level spiritual plants, which Lu Doudou has to admit.
This kind of person is just an example. It can't be that everyone in Dongning Village is a hidden medicine cultivator, right?
"But now you want those mortals to plant Biluolan, and you can't even supply basic spiritual energy to Biluolan."
It's not that Lu Doudou looks down on mortals, it's that spiritual plants like Biluo Lan require a lot of spiritual energy during their growth.
If the spiritual energy in the environment is insufficient, the monks need to use their own spiritual power to make up for it.
"How will you know if you don't try?" Xia Yihuo's voice was relaxed.
Her expression and tone were the same as when she said she was trying to find out the truth about Biluo Lan.
The last time she said she would give it a try, she grew three blue orchid plants in three days and discovered the new characteristics of the blue blue orchid.
This time she also said to give it a try.
Lu Doudou's expression gradually became weird. He couldn't really do it, could he?
Xia Yilu seems to have a magical power, no matter how outrageous things are, they can become reality in her body.
"I don't believe it." Lu Doudou curled his lips, "If people in any village can grow seventh-level spiritual plants, then why is there any need for a sect like Ziyun Sect to exist?"
Xia Yihuo didn't say anything more. When she put the facts in front of her, she had to believe it even if she didn't believe it.
"Let's go and have a look in the village first." She stood up, preparing to check the soil quality of Dongning Village and select a geomantic treasure land.
Lin Shuofeng followed Xia Yilu quickly wherever he went.
Lu Pingping also hurriedly caught up. She still believed Xia Yilu's words, "Sister Alfalfa, please wait for me. Can you also teach me how to grow blue orchids?"
"Of course, I promised you before."
Listening to the sound getting further and further away, Lu Doudou could only follow it although he was very reluctant.
To the east of the village is a large piece of flat land, a field specially developed for planting spiritual plants.
The previous wave of spiritual plants have been collected and handed over to the Ziyun Sect. The next batch of spiritual plants have not been planted yet, and most of the land is still empty.
Xia Yilu squatted down, took some soil, and rubbed it on his fingertips.
By injecting your own spiritual power into it, you can feel the surge of spiritual energy in it, which is much more convenient than the analysis of modern instruments.
She seemed to be a master of all things plant-related, knowing exactly what to do without even having to be told.
"Sister, what do you think?" Although Lin Shuofeng is a sword cultivator, he also knows that before planting spiritual plants, he needs to evaluate the quality of the land.
Lu Pingping and Lu Doudou could tell the quality of this land at a glance without even taking a closer look.Dao is a level that even the second-level spiritual plant requires a lot of effort.
